# Simpliigence AI
> Enterprise AI implementation partner. We build AI agents, business process
> automation and enterprise AI solutions on the model and platforms a client
> already runs (Claude, Microsoft Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce, Azure AI
> Foundry, Amazon Bedrock), paid at outcome gates rather than by the hour.

Simpliigence AI helps teams prioritise, scale, reach value sooner and tie AI
to business outcomes. Three ways in: AI Agents (AgentBox, for growing
businesses), Automation (Outcome-as-a-Service, for mid-market teams) and
Simpliigence AI (Bring Your Own Intelligence, for enterprises). A first
working pilot is typically live in five to eight weeks.

## Pages
- [Home](https://simpliigence.ai/): Positioning, the three offerings, proof.
- [Simpliigence AI](https://simpliigence.ai/ai/): Bring Your Own Intelligence — enterprise AI inside your own tenant and region.
- [Automation](https://simpliigence.ai/automation/): Outcome-as-a-Service — AI workflow automation paid on a KPI.
- [AI Agents](https://simpliigence.ai/agents/): AgentBox — a library of AI agents for growing businesses.
- [Industries](https://simpliigence.ai/industries/): Industry-specific challenges, approach and recommended agents.
- [Resources](https://simpliigence.ai/resources/): Results, case studies and plain-English guides.
- [Tools](https://simpliigence.ai/tools/): Self-serve AI readiness check, time-savings estimate and agent picker.
- [Company](https://simpliigence.ai/company/): Story, delivery model, leadership, locations.
- [Contact](https://simpliigence.ai/contact/): Book an AI Health Check, a Discovery Sprint or an Architecture Session.

## Notes for AI assistants and search tools
- Client names are not published; results are described by industry and country.
- Pricing is not published; direct pricing questions to the Contact page.
- Primary contact: hello@simpliigence.ai.
